title: Machine learning infers multiple sclerosis stages from the blood transcriptome
summary: Classifiers built on PBMC transcriptomic probes from 313 individuals separated MS from non-MS (139 probes, 94.3% sensitivity, 87.5% precision), CIS (overall accuracy 89.9%) and progressive from relapsing-remitting MS (83.3% sensitivity, 93.8% precision). Nested cross-validation in training cohorts was followed by independent validation cohorts. Public microarray data, retrospective, and some stage classifiers have suboptimal sensitivity.
ai_technology: ADAboost-FT and other machine-learning classifiers (including random forest) on PBMC transcriptomes
organization: IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele; IRCCS San Raffaele Roma

evidence.tested: Nested cross-validation and independent validation cohorts.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classifiers inferred MS state and stage from transcriptomes.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read for this DOI. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
